subtitle: What you sell or buy, saved once so invoice and bill lines fill themselves in.
name: Name
nameHint: As it should read on an invoice.
unitHint: pcs, kg, gaj, hour… printed after the quantity.
salePriceHint: Before VAT. Leave empty if you don't sell it.
purchasePriceHint: Before VAT. Leave empty if you don't buy it.
vatHint: Starting rate on a line. Each invoice can still change it.
emptyHint: Add the things you sell or buy most, and pick them on invoices and bills instead of typing.
totalsNote: Sold and bought count issued invoices and bills only, not drafts or voided ones. Stock on hand isn't tracked.
